column8: Can I get you anything else?\n

column8: What can I have for you?\n
column11: reads: さあ、何を買ってくれるんだい？\n @refalign

column8: Sorry. We cannot buy this.\n
column11: reads: あー、それうちじゃ扱ってないんだ。悪いね。\n @refalign

column8: What would you like to sell?\n
column11: reads: どれを売ってもらえるのかな？\n @refalign

column8: Sorry. Looks like you don't have enough money.\n
column11: reads: お金が足りないみたいだけど。\n @refalign

column8: Is this all?\n
column11: reads: これで全部かい？\n @refalign

column8: It looks like your inventory is full.\n
column11: reads: それ以上物を持てないようだね。\n @refalign

column8: Sorry, but I can't sell this at that price.\nNot even for you.\n
column11: @refalign
reads: 君でもそこまでは負けられないよ。\n

column8: Hmm, that's a little... How about this?\n
column11: reads: うーん、それじゃちょっとね‥‥。\nこれくらいでどう？\n @refalign

column6: 他の人には言わ{08:25}でくれよ。\n
column8: Just don't tell anyone else.\n
column11: reads: 他の人には言わないでくれよ。\n @refalign

column6: 毎度あり！\n大事に使{08:52}欲しいね。\n
column8: Thank you very much! Make good use of it, alright?\n
column11: reads: 毎度あり！\n大事に使って欲しいね。\n @refalign

column8: Is this all?\n
column11: reads: これで全部かい？\n @refalign

column8: No way. That would hardly be a fair trade.\n
column11: reads: 駄目だね。さすがにそれじゃあ、商売にならないよ。\n @refalign

column8: Hmm, let's see......\nCould you settle for about this much?\n
column11: reads: うーん、そうだなあ‥‥。\nこれぐらいで我慢してくれないかな。\n

column8: Okay. I'll purchase it at that price.\n
column11: reads: ＯＫ、その値で買ってあげるよ。\n @refalign

column8: Thank you very much. If you ever have something that you don't need,\ndo drop by and we'll buy it off you.\n
column11: reads: 毎度あり。いらないものがあったらまた引き取ってあげるよ。\n @refalign

column8: Oh, right. Please hold on.\n
column11: reads: あー、そうだ @refalign
reads: くん、ちょっと待って。\n

column8: Feel free to drop by whenever you need to buy something.\n
column11: reads: また何か買いたくなったら来なよ。それじゃ。\n @refalign

column8: Feel free to drop by whenever you need to sell something.\n
column11: reads: また何か売りたくなったら来なよ。じゃな。\n @refalign

column8: Please come by again.\n
column11: reads: また来なよ。ひやかしでも歓迎するよ。\n @refalign

column8: Shopkeeper:

column6: {08:48}をあげるよ。\nなあに遠慮は要ら{08:25}。お得意様{08:8A}ね。\n
